heartbeat.basis: knowledge-revocation-and-restoration.md: heartbeat every 30 seconds; independent monitor checks every 30 seconds; heartbeat age >90s alerts.

receiveCursor.note: The receive cursor is observed and reported; no alert threshold is invented for it in this task.

completeScanWatermark.basis: heartbeat normal but more than 2 minutes without a complete scan also alerts.

detection.basis: discovery takes at most 2 minutes (30s heartbeat / 30s check budget).

authorityIdentity.note: Health reads report the fixed Comet authority identity; the supervisor and reconciliation both key on it.

evidence.note: Deadline values are frozen from the original contract; capacity/failure evidence that freezes them operationally is still to be supplied by a real monitoring instance.
